notes.title: Price drop and Steam achievements
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30591453/4a01822d0901f01d698374f936f53cf28d365b23.png[/img]

Hello, players.

Today we have 2 good news on Madcap Castle!

[h2]Price drop[/h2]

We are pleased to a price reduction, going from $9,99 to $2,99.

[h2]Steam achievements added[/h2]

Steam achievements added. The challenges are hard, but you can do it!
